facts.effect: Tyre contact patch and carcass flex at operating temperature; pace-first balance vs thermal headroom.
facts.when: After 3–5 flying laps on slicks; adjust for stint length and ambient, not cold-pit targets.
telemetry_evidence: Hot stint median tyre_pressure per corner within 26–27 psi
Lap time stable across stint, not just pressure on a number

facts.effect: Higher hot window supports aquaplaning margin and heat retention in spray.
facts.when: Wet session once tyres are up to temp; avoid copying dry psi.
telemetry_evidence: Slip angles controlled; no chronic front overheating in straights

facts.lever: Camber, toe, brake migration, driving style
facts.effect: Core temp band drives grip level and degradation mode (grain vs blister).
facts.when: When diagnosing under/over temp on long runs or high kerb tracks.
telemetry_evidence: Grain/blister correlates with outside band + pressure mismatch

facts.effect: Platform attitude sets floor and wing efficiency; rake changes balance through speed slices.
facts.when: High-speed instability or mid-corner understeer that spring-only changes cannot fix.
telemetry_evidence: Speed vs ride attitude change at same wing
Corner entry understeer without excess rear slip on power

facts.effect: Mechanical roll stiffness and load transfer; sets transient balance before aero fully loads.
facts.when: Slow-corner balance, kerb compliance, or inside-wheel lift on crests.
telemetry_evidence: Lat G buildup vs steering trace at slow/medium corners
Suspension travel histogram extremes on kerbs

facts.effect: Controls tyre contact patch persistence over kerbs and platform decay in transitions.
facts.when: 1.10+ builds: refine after springs/ARB; entry/exit behavior still oscillates.
telemetry_evidence: Damper-speed bucket histogram peaks (low-speed platform, high-speed kerb)
Coast/oversteer on throttle lift tied to rear rebound

facts.effect: Traction on throttle vs rotation on entry; mid corner stability under combined load.
facts.when: Traction exits, mid-corner push, or violent power snaps.
telemetry_evidence: Throttle vs yaw_rate on corner exit
Rear slip spike when opening throttle early

facts.effect: Pedal aggression bandwidth; TC1 cuts power, TC2 reduces slip tolerance; ABS shapes trail-brake limit.
facts.when: After mechanical balance is sane — electronics amplify, not fix, roll stiffness errors.
telemetry_evidence: TC intervention counts vs throttle trace
ABS activation during trail brake without tyre lock spikes

facts.effect: Entry stability, steering authority, and front tyre temp on heavy stops.
facts.when: Forward entry understeer, rear instability under trail, or chronic LF overheating.
telemetry_evidence: Brake pressure/lines vs speed into braking zones
Front tyre temp rise only under braking, not mid-corner
